how: one run per template in a real n8n (CLI: n8n import:workflow + n8n execute; docker n8nio/n8n, the community node installed from npm as n8n installs it) against production coord.taifoon.dev, every credential value an env expression (the key is never in a file); the answer node's output recorded here

chat-on-one-key.n8n: 2.45.5 (docker n8nio/n8n:2.45.5; CLI: import:workflow + execute, the Taifoon Relayer API key an env expression)
notes: the chat is the Taifoon node's Inference → Chat (POST /v1/chat/completions) on the Taifoon Relayer API credential; the agreements are Agreement → List / Accept
the debit is 0.000011 USDC under OWN_INFERENCE_PRICE_v1 (our own card's per-token price), so the template says "up to 0.001 USDC per answer", never a fixed price
the channel is the credential's Channel ID (n8n when empty): the node sends it on every call, so the sale names n8n, not n8n-template:chat-on-one-key
an invalid key in the same n8n: Chat continues on the failure and Answer returns { ok: false, error: { code, status 401, type, sdk AuthenticationError, … } }, nothing charged
superseded: the raw HTTP version ran 2026-10-21T08:27:16Z on n8n 2.43.8 (sale gpu_mvhums5y_0e0a9551f3, 0.000006 USDC)
